title: Redpoint RPI Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for the Redpoint Interaction (RPI) Helm chart v7.7

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name used in resource names

global.description: Global settings shared across all chart components

mode.description: Deployment mode: standard (production deployment) or demo (embedded MSSQL + MongoDB for local dev/evaluation).

platform.description: Cloud environment: azure, amazon, google, or selfhosted

images.description: Container image settings for all RPI services

registry.description: Container image registry and repository path

imagePullSecret.description: Image pull secret for private registries

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes image pull secret

overrides.description: Per-service image overrides. When set, the value is used verbatim instead of {registry}/{service-name}:{tag}. Useful for flat registries (e.g., ECR with all images in a single repo).

podTimezone.description: Set the pod timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York'); leave empty for default UTC

databases.description: Database configuration for operational and data warehouse connections

googleWorkloadIdentity.description: Authenticate to Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL via GKE Workload Identity (Application Default Credentials). Requires provider=postgresql, global.deployment.platform=google, and cloudIdentity.enabled=true; cannot be combined with cloudSqlProxy.enabled.

databaseSchema.description: Schema the Deployment API uses within the operational database

server_host.description: Database server hostname or IP address

pulse_database_name.description: Name of the Pulse operational database

pulse_logging_database_name.description: Name of the Pulse logging database

encrypt.description: Enable TLS encryption for database connections

cloudSqlProxy.description: Google Cloud SQL Auth Proxy sidecar (GKE only; activates when platform=google, provider=postgresql, and enabled=true)

enabled.description: Enable the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy sidecar

connectionName.description: Cloud SQL instance connection name in the form 'project:region:instance'

image.description: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container image (verbatim URI)

port.description: Local port the proxy listens on; used as ConnectionSettings__Port

privateIp.description: Connect to the Cloud SQL private IP (requires VPC peering)

autoIamAuthn.description: Use IAM database authentication instead of password auth

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy sidecar.

bigquery.description: BigQuery data-warehouse configuration independent of the RPI hosting platform (supported on Azure, AWS, and Google). Each connection defines its own authentication configuration, including a service-account key via its own KeyFilePath or the configured workload-identity/ADC mode. BigQuery credentials are configured independently from cloudIdentity.google.

name.description: Connection name (used as the ODBC DSN name).

credentialsType.description: serviceAccount: authenticate with a mounted service account key (provide serviceAccountEmail, configMapName, keyName). workloadIdentity: keyless, using the pod's Workload Identity service account.

OAuthMechanism.description: BigQuery ODBC driver auth mode: 0 for a service account key; the driver's Application Default Credentials value (typically 3) for workloadIdentity.

serviceAccountEmail.description: Service account email. Used only with credentialsType=serviceAccount.

configMapName.description: Kubernetes ConfigMap holding the service account key. Used only with credentialsType=serviceAccount.

keyName.description: Data key within the ConfigMap. Used only with credentialsType=serviceAccount. The credential mounts at /app/google-creds/bigquery/<connection name>.json regardless of the key name.

mountPath.description: Mount path for Snowflake key files (default: /app/snowflake-creds)

secretProviderClassName.description: CSI SecretProviderClass name for mounting keys from vault

keys.description: Snowflake private key files. Each entry has keyName and optional secretName.

secretName.description: K8s Secret containing the key file (kubernetes provider only)

cloudIdentity.description: Pod-to-cloud authentication. Required for sdk and csi secrets modes. Authentication mechanism derived from global.deployment.platform.

enabled.description: Enable cloud identity for pod authentication to cloud services

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount configuration. shared=one SA for all pods; per-service=each service gets its own SA.

mode.description: shared: one SA for all pods. per-service: each service gets its own SA.

managedIdentityClientId.description: Azure Managed Identity Client ID for Workload Identity

google.description: Platform-level Google Cloud identity for the RPI platform. Rendered only when global.deployment.platform is google and used by Google platform services such as Cloud Storage, Secret Manager, Pub/Sub, and Cloud SQL proxy. BigQuery authentication is configured independently under databases.datawarehouse.bigquery.

configMapName.description: ConfigMap containing the service account JSON credentials

keyName.description: Key file name within the ConfigMap

roleArn.description: IAM Role ARN for IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts)

useAccessKeys.description: Inject AWS access keys from the main K8s Secret (AWS_Access_Key_ID, AWS_Secret_Access_Key)

secretsManagement.description: How secrets are provided to pods: kubernetes (K8s Secret), sdk (cloud vault at runtime), or csi (CSI driver syncs vault to K8s Secret)

secretName.description: Name of the pre-created Kubernetes secret containing application credentials

sdk.description: SDK settings — app reads from cloud vault directly (provider: sdk)

useForAppSettings.description: Read app settings (including the database connection) from the cloud vault. Keep true in SDK mode (all clouds).

useForConfigPasswords.description: Store RPI config passwords in the cloud vault. Set false to keep them in the operational database instead (some vaults reject empty secret values).

configurationReloadIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds to reload configuration from vault

useADTokenForDatabaseConnection.description: Use Azure AD token for database connections

secretTagKey.description: Tag key used to filter secrets in AWS Secrets Manager

csi.description: CSI driver settings — syncs cloud vault to K8s Secret (provider: csi)

secretName.description: K8s secret name created by the CSI driver

parameters.description: Provider-specific driver parameters, passed verbatim to the SecretProviderClass (keys differ per provider).

secretObjects.description: Kubernetes Secret synced from mounted objects.

type.description: Kubernetes Secret type (e.g. Opaque, kubernetes.io/tls).

data.description: Key mapping inside the synced Secret.

key.description: Key inside the synced Kubernetes Secret.

objectName.description: Vault object whose value fills the key.

secretName.description: Kubernetes Secret the driver syncs the objects into.

provider.description: CSI secrets-store provider (azure, aws, gcp, vault).

syncService.description: Which service's pod mounts the SecretProviderClass to trigger the CSI sync into the Kubernetes Secret (none disables the sync pod).

storage.description: Storage configuration for persistent volume claims and volumes

storageClass.description: Optional StorageClass for CSI-backed storage (EFS, Azure File, etc.)

mountOptions.description: Mount options for the chart-managed StorageClass.

volumeBindingMode.description: Volume binding mode of the chart-managed StorageClass (Immediate or WaitForFirstConsumer).

DataManagementUploadDirectory.description: PVC for data management upload directory

persistentVolumes.description: Create PV + PVC pairs (for CSI-backed storage)

dynamicPVCs.description: Additional PersistentVolumeClaims the chart creates from the storage class.

realtimeapi.description: Realtime API service configuration — handles real-time decisioning, caching, and queue processing

replicas.description: Number of Realtime API pod replicas

rpiClientID.description: RPI Client ID (GUID) for this realtime instance

clientAddressOverrides.description: Per-client Realtime API address overrides. Requires realtimeapi.multitenant=true (only meaningful with multiple Realtime API instances); render fails if set on a single-tenant deployment. Clients not listed use the cluster-wide address.

clientId.description: Client (tenant) GUID this override applies to

address.description: Realtime API base address for that client

geolocation.description: Realtime geolocation settings (weather / location enrichment). Defaults use the native Azure provider; a custom provider can be supplied via the plugin fields. The provider APIKey is not set here - it is supplied via the shared RPI Secret key RealtimeAPI_Geolocation_APIKey (kubernetes/csi) or the cloud vault (sdk).

enabled.description: Enable geolocation config injection. When false (default) no geolocation env vars are emitted and no APIKey secret is referenced. When true, the settings below apply and RealtimeAPI_Geolocation_APIKey becomes a required secret key (kubernetes/csi).

provider.description: Geolocation provider. Native value is Azure; any other value denotes a custom provider configured via the plugin fields.

pluginAssembly.description: Assembly name of a custom geolocation provider plugin (blank uses the native provider)

pluginType.description: Fully qualified type of the custom geolocation provider plugin

pluginSettings.description: Key/value settings passed to the custom geolocation provider plugin

coordsCacheTimespanMinutesIPLookup.description: Minutes to cache coordinates resolved via IP lookup

pluginAssembly.description: Assembly name of a custom IP-lookup plugin

pluginType.description: Fully qualified type of the custom IP-lookup plugin

pluginSettings.description: Key/value settings passed to the custom IP-lookup plugin

identitySettings.description: How a known visitor's profile is keyed once they identify themselves (querystring, cached attribute list, or Realtime cache offer).

masterKeyName.description: Principal key used to identify a known visitor's profile (e.g. CustomerKey). Blank keeps the RPI-assigned GUID (the variable is not emitted).

masterKeyAliases.description: Alternative names the master key may appear under (e.g. CK for CustomerKey)

alternativeKeys.description: Additional keys that can also identify a visitor, linked to the master key via a querystring or a populated Realtime cache

mergeParameters.description: Merge querystring parameters into the visitor profile

mergeCALAttributes.description: Merge cached-attribute-list attributes into the visitor profile

parameterMergeExclusions.description: Querystring parameter names to exclude from the merge

calMergeExclusions.description: Cached-attribute-list attribute names to exclude from the merge

type.description: Authentication type for the Realtime API

CORSOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins for the Realtime API

dataMaps.description: Per-DataMap overrides. An empty Cache inherits the effective cacheProvider.provider.

Cache.description: Cache assignment; empty inherits the effective cacheProvider.provider.

RealtimeServerCookieEnabled.description: Enable the Realtime server visitor cookie.

RealtimeServerCookieName.description: Name of the Realtime server visitor cookie.

RealtimeServerCookieExpires.description: Realtime server visitor cookie lifetime in days.

RealtimeServerCookieHttpOnly.description: Mark the Realtime server visitor cookie HttpOnly.

RealtimeServerCookieDomain.description: Optional Domain attribute for the Realtime server visitor cookie. Unset leaves the cookie host-only (the variable is not emitted).

provider.description: Cache provider type. Empty resolves to the platform default: google -> googlebigtable, azure/amazon/selfhosted -> mongodb.

authMechanism.description: MongoDB authentication: default (connection string from the shared Secret) or iamRole (MONGODB-AWS via IRSA / Pod Identity).

roleArn.description: IAM role ARN for MONGODB-AWS (authMechanism=iamRole only).

region.description: AWS region for the STS endpoint (authMechanism=iamRole only).

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the chart-managed Realtime Redis.

volumeClaimTemplates.description: Persistent volume claim template for the chart-managed Realtime Redis.

type.description: Redis deployment type: internal (chart-managed) or external (BYO)

provider.description: Queue provider type. Empty resolves to the platform default: azure -> azureservicebus, amazon -> amazonsqs, google -> googlepubsub, selfhosted -> rabbitmq.

queueNames.description: Queue name configuration for each message type

visibilityTimeout.description: SQS message visibility timeout in seconds.

azureeventhubs.description: Azure Event Hubs queue provider settings

rabbitmqSettings.description: RabbitMQ settings. username defaults to the release namespace; hostname applies to external (BYO) RabbitMQ.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the chart-managed Realtime RabbitMQ.

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget for the chart-managed Realtime RabbitMQ.

volumeClaimTemplates.description: Persistent volume claim template for the chart-managed Realtime RabbitMQ.

hostname.description: RabbitMQ host. The chart-managed broker name for type internal; the customer broker host for type external.

type.description: RabbitMQ deployment type: internal (chart-managed) or external (BYO)

resources.description: CPU and memory resource requests and limits

RealtimeAgentAddress.description: Address of the Interaction Realtime Agent. Unset leaves the application default.

RealtimeAgentInProcessPath.description: Path to the in-process Realtime Agent assembly. Unset leaves the application default.

SaveProfilePostDecisionResponse.description: Persist the visitor profile after returning a decision response.

CachedAttributeLoadTimeoutMS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for loading cached attribute lists. 0 uses the application default.

MessageHistoryProfileRecordLimit.description: Maximum message-history records retained per visitor profile.

MessageHistoryDaysInProfile.description: Days of message history retained in the visitor profile.

MaxNoEventMetadataInstances.description: Maximum number of event metadata instances retained.

RedPointMLServiceAddress.description: RedPoint ML service address. Unset leaves the application default.

RedPointMLClientID.description: RedPoint ML client identifier. Unset leaves the application default.

EnableProfileMergeEvents.description: Emit events when visitor profiles are merged.

TrackProfileMergeInSourceProfile.description: Record the merge on the source profile when profiles are merged.

RegionLanguageCodeParameter.description: Parameter name carrying the region language code. Unset leaves the application default.

WebVisitorCacheDuration.description: Web visitor cache duration in minutes. 0 uses the application default.

EventDaysToPersistOverride.description: Number of days to persist web events. The chart always sets this value; override it to change the retention.

MaxNoVisitorDevicesAllowed.description: Maximum number of devices tracked per visitor.

parameterToDataMappings.description: Mappings from an inbound parameter to a cached attribute list.

serviceHost.description: This Realtime API's own host and port (used for callbacks).

name.description: Service host name (empty = derived at runtime).

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations added to this service's pods.

podLabels.description: Extra labels added to this service's pods.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes waits for the pod to stop gracefully before killing it.

type.description: Workload kind: deployment (Kubernetes Deployment) or rollout (Argo Rollout). Stateful services use StatefulSet.

logging.description: Realtime API and Realtime Agent log levels.

nlogTarget.description: Name of an NLog target to which Realtime API log events are also written (the image defines async and logconsole). Empty, the default, disables it and the variable is not emitted.

CacheOutputCollectIPAddress.description: Include the visitor IP address in cache output.

CacheWebFormData.description: Store submitted web-form data in the realtime cache.

EventListeningLocalCacheDuration.description: Seconds event-listening data is held in the local cache.

HashVisitorID.description: Hash visitor IDs before storing them.

ThresholdBetweenPageVisitsMinutes.description: Minutes between requests that start a new page visit.

ThresholdBetweenSiteVisitsMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity after which a new site visit begins.

cacheOutputQueueEnabled.description: Publish cache output to the cache-output queue.

decisionCacheDuration.description: Seconds a decision result is cached.

enableAuditMetricsInHeaders.description: Return audit metrics in response headers.

enableHelpPages.description: Serve the Realtime API help pages.

permittedCharacters.description: Additional characters permitted in deviceID values.

enableDeviceIDValidation.description: Validate incoming device IDs against the deviceID rules.

enableVisitorIDValidation.description: Validate incoming visitor IDs against the visitorID rules.

permittedCharacters.description: Additional characters permitted in visitorID values.

multitenant.description: Run the Realtime API in multi-tenant mode. Required for realtimeapi.clientAddressOverrides.

callbackapi.description: Callback API service configuration — handles callback channel processing (e.g., SendGrid)

enableHttpsRedirection.description: Enable app-level HTTPS redirection. Default false (leave off behind a TLS-terminating ingress).

replicas.description: Callback API replicas. Applies to the standard deployment and, when multitenancy.enabled is true, to every per-tenant instance deployment.

instances.description: Per-tenant Callback API instances rendered when multitenancy.enabled is true. Each instance uses callbackapi.replicas.

failOnCacheConnectionError.description: Fail startup if the cache connection cannot be established.

behavior.description: HPA scaling behavior (scaleUp/scaleDown stabilization and policies).

periodSeconds.description: Length of the policy period in seconds.

value.description: Amount the policy may change the replica count per period.

stabilizationWindowSeconds.description: Seconds of metric history considered before a scaleDown decision.

jobExecution.description: Execution Service job and workflow execution tuning.

auditTaskEvents.description: Write task lifecycle events to the audit log.
